blocks.text: Periodic table ke group 17 (VIIA) ke elements halogens hain: fluorine, chlorine, bromine, iodine, astatine aur tennessine. Yeh bohat reactive non-metals hain, kimiyai khusoosiyat mein ek doosre se khase milte julte; pehle chaar aam arkan hain, jabke astatine aur tennessine bohat nayab (rare) aur radioactive hain. Naam halogen Greek 'halos', namak, aur 'gen', banane wala, se aaya hai. Chlorine pehla halogen tha jo alag kiya aur element ke taur par pehchana gaya; zehreela hone ke bawajood chloride ki shakal mein us ki thori miqdar zindagi ke liye zaroori hai.

Halogens sab phases mein diatomic molecules ke taur par maujood hain. Fluorine aur chlorine kamre ke darja hararat aur dabao par halke peele aur sabzi-mail peele rang ki gases hain; bromine surkh-bhoori udne wali (volatile) liquid hai jis ke dhuen corrosive aur zehreele hain; iodine chamakdar slate-kala solid hai jo seedha banafshi bukharat mein sublime hota hai (Figure 13.1). Halogens ke rang chlorine se iodine tak batadreej gehre hote hain, molecules ke andar electron transitions se roshni ke jazb hone mein tabdeeli ki wajah se.

blocks.prompt: Kaun se halogens radioactive hain, aur halogens rang mein kyun mukhtalif hain (Quick Check 13.1a, b)?
blocks.explanation: Astatine aur tennessine nayab, radioactive arkan hain. Rang X2 molecules ke andar electron transitions se nazar aane wali roshni ke jazb hone se paida hote hain; transition ki energy group mein neeche jate badalti hai, to jazb aur guzarne wale rang sarakte hain aur elements halke peele fluorine se slate-kale iodine tak gehre hote hain.

items: Group 17 halogens (namak banane wale): F, Cl, Br, I aam; At, Ts nayab aur radioactive; reactive non-metals, sab phases mein diatomic.
F2 halka peela gas, Cl2 sabzi-mail peela gas, Br2 surkh-bhoora liquid, I2 slate-kala solid banafshi bukharat mein sublime; rang group mein neeche gehre (electron transitions se roshni ka jazb).
